decision: Reopened a ticket that had been closed prematurely. The tenant self-swapped the appliance (event-008) and the landlord approved an inspection minutes later (event-009), while the agency promised the tenant a visit "when you're back" (event-010) and then marked the job complete without payment (event-011, event-012). No contractor is instructed and no spend is committed: there is no standing spend cap on file and the landlord's approval names no amount, so a priced quote must be approved before work (APR-SPEND-OVER-CAP, RTE-LANDLORD). I replied to the landlord's chase (event-013) with the position and the decision he owns, asked the tenant for a return date and access windows plus a leak/electrical check after the DIY swap, logged the reopening and the premature closure, and put the case on hold. The ticket now waits on two named parties, so it finishes as request_info rather than an escalation; no safety hazard has been reported by any party.
